customer_message: Hi, I was charged $49.99 twice this month for my Pro plan. Can you refund the duplicate charge?
context: Account: Pro plan, $49.99/mo. Billing log shows two charges of $49.99 on 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-04, 24 hours apart — confirmed duplicate due to a known billing-retry bug. Policy: duplicate charges are refunded in full within 5-7 business days, no support ticket escalation needed.

customer_message: My package says delivered but I never got it. This is the second time this has happened with your shipping. I'm really frustrated.
context: Order #58231, marked delivered 2026-08-10 via carrier tracking, left at front door per delivery photo. Customer has one prior lost-package claim from 2026-05-02, resolved with reshipment. Policy: for delivered-but-not-received claims, offer reshipment or refund after a 48-hour carrier investigation window; acknowledge repeat issue if customer has a prior claim on file.

customer_message: I want to cancel my subscription. Also, do I get a refund for the rest of this month?
context: Account: Growth plan, $99/mo, billed on the 1st, today is the 15th. Policy: subscriptions can be canceled anytime and remain active through the end of the paid billing period; no partial-month refunds are issued per the Terms of Service.

customer_message: I can't log in. It keeps saying invalid password even though I know it's right. I've tried resetting it twice and never get the email.
context: Account email on file: j.torres@example.com (unverified bounce flag set 2026-07-28 — emails to this address have been bouncing since a typo was introduced during a profile edit). Policy: if email is bouncing, verify/correct the email on file via identity verification (security questions) before resending password reset.

customer_message: The dashboard has been throwing a 500 error every time I try to export my data as CSV. Been happening for 2 days.
context: Status page: known incident INC-2291, CSV export service degraded since 2026-08-12 09:00 UTC, fix ETA 2026-08-15. Workaround available: export as JSON instead, which is unaffected. Policy: acknowledge known incidents by ID, give ETA, offer workaround if one exists.

customer_message: What's your policy on refunds for annual plans if I decide it's not for me after a few months?
context: Policy: annual plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee from the purchase date; after 30 days, annual plans are non-refundable but can be downgraded to monthly at the next renewal. No account-specific data needed for this general policy question.

customer_message: This is the third email I've sent about my billing issue and NO ONE has responded. I'm about to cancel and tell everyone I know not to use this product.
context: Ticket history shows 2 prior unanswered emails from this customer over 6 days about an incorrect $150 charge (should have been $75 per their Starter plan pricing). Charge is confirmed to be a pricing-table error affecting a batch of Starter accounts migrated on 2026-08-01. Policy: for confirmed pricing errors, refund the difference immediately and acknowledge the support delay explicitly.

customer_message: Do you offer a student discount?
context: Policy: 20% student discount available with a valid .edu email or verified student ID via SheerID, applies to monthly and annual plans, not stackable with other promo codes.

customer_message: I upgraded to Pro last week but I'm still seeing the Basic plan features in my dashboard. Also my invoice still shows the old price.
context: Account: upgrade to Pro processed 2026-08-09 in billing system, but feature-flag sync to the app dashboard failed for this account per internal logs (known edge case for accounts upgraded via the mobile app). Invoice for 2026-08-01 correctly reflects Basic pricing (upgrade was after that billing date); next invoice will reflect Pro pricing. Policy: escalate feature-flag sync failures to engineering with account ID, explain invoice timing is expected.

customer_message: hey so i think i need help with something but not sure who to ask, my account is kind of messed up
context: No specific account issue flagged in the system — account status is normal, no open tickets, no billing anomalies, no failed logins. No context available to diagnose a specific problem from this message alone.

customer_message: I used promo code SUMMER25 at checkout but it didn't apply. I was charged full price.
context: Promo code SUMMER25 expired 2026-08-01; customer's order was placed 2026-08-06, after expiration. Policy: expired codes cannot be retroactively applied; if a customer was actively shown the code as valid at checkout due to a caching bug (confirmed bug ID CB-114 active 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-07), the discount should be honored as a goodwill exception.

customer_message: Can I get an itemized invoice for my last 3 payments? I need it for expense reporting.
context: Billing history: 3 charges of $49.99 on 2026-06-01, 2026-07-01, 2026-08-01, all Pro plan, all successful. Itemized invoices are auto-generated PDFs available for self-serve download under Billing > Invoice History in the account dashboard.

customer_message: Your product deleted my project. 3 weeks of work. I need it back immediately or I'm switching to a competitor today.
context: Project 'Q3-Launch-Deck' shows as deleted by the account owner 2026-08-11 14:32 UTC via the dashboard delete action (not a system error). Policy: deleted projects are recoverable from a 30-day soft-delete trash for Pro+ plans; this account is on Pro, so recovery is possible via Settings > Trash, self-serve, no engineering escalation needed.

customer_message: Is there an API rate limit? I'm building an integration and want to plan around it.
context: Policy/docs: Pro plan API rate limit is 100 requests/minute, 50,000/day; Enterprise plan is 1,000 requests/minute with no daily cap; rate limit headers are returned on every API response (X-RateLimit-Remaining).

customer_message: I was double billed AND my export feature is broken AND nobody has responded to my last email in 4 days. Can someone actually help?
context: Billing: single charge of $49.99 on 2026-08-01, no duplicate found in logs — customer may be confusing this with a pending-then-settled bank authorization hold, common false-duplicate pattern. Export: same known incident INC-2291 as t05 (CSV export degraded, JSON workaround available). Prior email: 1 unanswered email from 4 days ago found in ticket history requesting export help. Policy: address each part separately, explain the bank-hold explanation for billing with an offer to check further if the customer disagrees, reference the known incident, and acknowledge the support delay.

customer_message: Quick question — can I change my plan's billing email without changing my login email?
context: Policy: billing email and login email are independent fields in Account Settings; billing email can be changed at any time under Settings > Billing > Billing Contact without affecting login credentials.
